input.text: Fictional applications, health declarations, structured eClaimLink-style claims, bills, coding lookups, plan rules, member history and provider statistics; ~300 claims/day

work.text: Five Pi Durable agents use JSON-schema tools in loops: enrollment, bill matching, coding review, coverage adjudication, and fraud review

output.text: Eligibility decisions and ICD-10-CM prefixes; bill mismatches; coding findings; per-line pay/deny with codes; fraud signals 0–1 and pay/review/hold; tool-recorded results

criteria.text: Best quality and reliable tool calling above cost; existing Langfuse 14-claim dataset with agent, call and end-to-end scores; two enrollment fixtures; human approves each claim

constraints.text: Endpoints must process health data in UAE; unknown treated outside UAE; fictional data permits non-UAE endpoint as documented residency gap; Cloudflare Workers AI and OpenRouter in use

assumptions: One distinct model per agent, repeated calls share model; no assured UAE-processing endpoint until verified per route.
Quality estimates based on public benchmarks pending the existing Langfuse experiments; human approval reduces but does not eliminate adjudication harm.

tasks.output: Recorded line decisions and denial codes
